description: This Dart file defines a Flutter screen widget 'DocumentViewScreen' which displays a single document, providing features such as preview (image or text), sharing, editing metadata, and deleting the document. It interacts with document models, repositories, and file services.

classes.name: DocumentViewScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays and manages interactions with a single document, including preview, edit, delete, and share functionalities.

classes.name: _HeaderMeta
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays the document's icon, name, and notes or MIME type.

classes.name: _GenericPreview
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a generic placeholder for files with unsupported previews, offering a share button.

classes.name: _ActionBar
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides action buttons for sharing, editing, and deleting the document.

classes.name: _PreviewError
classes.description: A widget to display an error message when an image preview fails.

classes.name: _NotFoundBody
classes.description: A widget shown when the document is not found.

methods.name: _loadDocument
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the document data, determines its MIME type and preview capability, and sets the widget's state accordingly.

methods.name: _share
methods.description: Shares the document file via the share service.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes the document record from the repository, removes the stored file, and navigates back with user feedback.

methods.name: _edit
methods.description: Prompts the user to edit document metadata and updates the repository.

methods.name: _promptEdit
methods.description: Displays a dialog for editing the document's name and notes/tags.

methods.name: _reload
methods.description: Reloads the document data from the repository.

methods.name: _buildPreviewArea
methods.description: Builds the appropriate preview widget based on document type (image, text, or generic).
